messages:
Ivy Park: Heads-up: CloudLane just notified procurement that PO#11420 will ship in two tranches. Original was single delivery 2025-05-08; new plan: 40% by 2025-05-03, remainder ~2025-06-10.
Marco Li: That's rough. Which units are delayed?
Ivy Park: Delayed: r5-48 high-memory and the r6-64 SKU. Lower-density r5-32 unaffected.
Sofia Grant: Our integration partner needs parity for certification. If parity missing, they won't sign-off for the marketplace integration next week.
Tara (revops): Sales has three launch customers slated to migrate starting 5/12. We need to know if we can support them on reduced capacity.
Marco Li: Short options: 1) reduce canary cohort, 2) use hybrid routing to hosted fallback, 3) delay high-throughput features. All increase risk/cost.
VendorBot: CloudLane portal note: "assembly backlog + customs slot delay". Short-term concession offered: 30 days waived rack fees for delayed units.
Legal-BOT: Any waiver/credit needs an amendment. I'll prepare a short-form amendment template; please request specifics (dates, SKUs, credit schedule).
Ivy Park: Action: I'll request a split manifest with serial ranges and firm tranche ETAs by EOD. Also asking for a written concession and amendment draft.
Sofia Grant: Action: I'll confirm which validation tests require full SKU parity and provide a reduced test plan if needed.
Tara (revops): Action: I'll draft two customer messaging templates: (A) limited scale migration, (B) delayed GA + partner webinar.
Marco Li: If we don't have manifest by 3pm PT tomorrow, recommend postponing co-announcement and running a partner webinar on 5/14.
Ivy Park: Agreed. Will update when manifest or amendment arrives.
VendorBot: Reminder scheduled for 15:00 PT tomorrow.
Ivy Park: Update (partner reply): Manifest posted: https://cloudlane.files/po/11420/manifest-partial - shows 40% tranche early. Concession note: 30 days waived fees + $25k credit if >30% shortfall after 45 days.
Sofia Grant: I'll run a fast impact matrix and post numbers within 2 hours.
Tara (revops): Hold public comms until legal signs off on the amendment.
